notes: One measured run per configuration; mode1 is an exploratory run with incomplete staging sampling and overlapping small integration tests; 1-repeat is the comparison run.
End-to-end starts at persisted batch started_at and includes refresh, all IDs/generations and authenticated sample reader verification.
Queue residence is a trapezoidal estimate from ~1 s samples, not individual enqueue/dequeue tracing.
Per-process CPU is sampled, so exited processes may lose their final unsampled interval. Container CPU/I/O covers the full campaign including verification.
Benchmark image predates final guard preventing concurrent failures from overwriting paused/blocked batch state; successful ingest path is unchanged.

Entity IDs scoped to a local work UUID are verified against the production key function, then normalized to external-work scope for comparison. OpenSearch excludes local id/snapshot/generation/epoch and ingestion archived_at only. Keyword tag arrays are sorted as sets, preserving duplicates; text and bibliographic values are retained. Raw hashes are also retained.
65,536-entry backpressure threshold is implemented but not reached by this 11,032-work campaign. No full-dump capacity claim.
Parser process sample includes adapter parents and pool children, but not Python resource trackers; configured absolute bound is parsers + 2 * effective source lanes.
Observation objects retain their source/evidence fields; work UUIDs and snapshot/manifest references are validated and normalized before comparison.
Full corpus replay is a separate untimed check; transaction concurrency includes pool acquisition.
